slidev-default-build.zip

An ordinary `slidev build` output, used by the tests of the in-browser
Slidev build conversion (src/lib/slidev-convert.ts). It was made with
@slidev/cli 53.1.0 and @slidev/theme-default 0.25.0 and default settings:
base path "/", the history router, and Slidev's Google Fonts and favicon
links. The ZIP holds the dist folder unchanged, including every KaTeX font
file (woff2, woff and ttf), so the archive is about 1.2 MB.

The deck (five slides and the QuantumInterference Vue component) is adapted
from this repository's Slidev example in tools/slidev and is covered by the
repository's MIT license.

under its own license, which continues to apply:

  Copyright (c) 2020 Anthony Fu.
